title: GalliPixel-FontPack

body:
!["Galli Pixel" written with the GalliPixel font](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73ee72283ff354c0162f9ecc3f300dcab0790baf.png)

### Caxton
This pack requires [Caxton](https://modrinth.com/mod/caxton) to load the font.

# GalliPixel
Gallipixel is a pixel-style font based on [Sherman's Gallifreyan](https://shermansplanet.com/gallifreyan/).

# Gallifreyan
Gallifreyan is the fictional language of the Time Lords from the TV show Doctor Who. In 2011, Loren Sherman created a circular writing system inspired by it, which has since been adopted by fans around the world and even officially recognized by the show.


!["Thank u" written with the GalliPixel font](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f06a6a2b8cc40d4c8db5f12bb2ab78e946767a6.png)
